verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs emphasize that local data never leaves the machine and isn't tracked (ollama-docs-6, ollama-docs-7), implying user control/openness, but there's no documented explicit 'export all data' feature, and a concrete community report claims Ollama actually locks users in via a proprietary model registry format with hashed filenames that don't work with other tools (ollama-comm-8), directly contradicting the open-format portability claim. Missing for 10: an official data/model export mechanism, documentation of open storage formats, and independent corroboration resolving the lock-in dispute.
